scope: Cross-domain mathematical certificate + symbolic diagnostic antichain; no actual SBCL/Prolog oracle parity or runtime hardware diagnosis claimed; mathematical algorithms independently verified over finite ranges

rows.argument_shape: (samples:finite-list-of-exact-rationals, max_degree:d>=0 with len(samples)>=d+2)-> CERTIFIED(initial differences through d,next exact value) or NOT_CERTIFIED(first nonzero (d+1)-difference index,value)
rows.behavior: For at least d+2 equally-spaced exact samples, certify their table has identically zero (d+1)th forward differences; on success expose first forward differences orders 0..d and one exact next sample by Newton's finite binomial formula. On failure show the first nonzero (d+1)-difference. Return INSUFFICIENT-DATA if fewer than d+2 samples; no claim about future physical samples or noise.
falsifiers: Claim any 3 samples certify degree<=2; fourth independent datum is required
Lose exact rational values to floating point
Claim predicted next mathematical sample must match noisy astronomical observations
rows.dedup_check: No exact name in ratified D1–D9 or selected D10 at 635; unlike interpolation of n samples, requires independent (d+1)-difference zero witnesses. It is a derived algebraic invariant potentially suitable to Core-Math; no claim of irreducibility.
rows.source_title: Charles Babbage, A Note respecting the Application of Machinery to the Calculation of Astronomical Tables (1822), Memoirs RAS Vol 1, p.309
rows.source_scope: Historical inspiration and finite-difference mechanism; precise certification/error-output interface is a modern SENS research proposal, not an alleged Babbage API.

rows.argument_shape: (components:finite-set, complete_conflicts:finite-family-of-subsets-of-components) -> all inclusion-minimal hitting sets, as a set-family (canonical order only for serialization)
rows.behavior: Given a complete family of system conflict sets already derived from a model and observations, return all inclusion-minimal component subsets intersecting every conflict. Empty family returns singleton empty diagnosis; any empty conflict yields no diagnosis. This does not itself derive conflicts, identify real-world broken hardware, or assign Bayesian probabilities.
falsifiers: Return {A,B,C} despite strict subset {B} hitting every conflict
Merge empty conflict and no conflicts into the same result
Call a hitting set a proven broken component without complete conflict evidence
Confuse minimum-cardinality with inclusion-minimal, which may have differing sizes
rows.dedup_check: D9 truth maintenance tracks justifications and derived facts, but does not expose the complete antichain of minimal transversals for an input conflict hypergraph. Abductive explanations pursue enough hypotheses to entail a goal, not necessarily a transversal of every known inconsistency; independent equivalence/core-or-library review still needed.
rows.source_title: Raymond Reiter, A theory of diagnosis from first principles, Artificial Intelligence 32(1), pp.57–95, April 1987, DOI 10.1016/0004-3702(87)90062-2
rows.source_scope: Finite conflict-family restriction of Reiter's hitting-set correspondence. Complete set of conflicts is an explicit precondition; diagnosis from system observations alone is NOT claimed.
